question: What is the parent technique of attack technique 'T1542.003: Pre-OS Boot: Bootkit'?
answer_text:
Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
Found ATT&CK record T1542.003: Bootkit. T1542.003 (Bootkit): Adversaries may use bootkits to persist on systems. A bootkit is a malware variant that modifies the boot sectors of a hard drive, allowing malicious code to execute before a computer's operating system has loaded. Bootkits reside at a layer below the operating system and may make it difficult to perform full remediation unless an organization suspects one was used and can act accordingly.

In BIOS systems, a bootkit may modify the Master Boot Record (MBR) and/or Volume Boot Record (VBR).(Citation: Mandiant M Trends 2016) The MBR is the section of disk that is first loaded after completing hardware initialization by the BIOS.
